gaps.sentence: 'I moved here two years ago,' he explained. He explained that he had moved there two years ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Ago' becomes 'before' (or 'earlier') in reported speech; here → there as well.

gaps.sentence: 'The flight leaves now,' the announcer said. The announcer said that the flight left ___.
gaps.explanation: Now becomes then in reported speech.

gaps.sentence: 'We won't stay long,' they said. They said they ___ stay long.
gaps.explanation: will not → would not (wouldn't) after a past reporting verb.

gaps.sentence: "Congratulations!" — She ___ me on passing the exam.
"I am sorry I am late." — He ___ for being late.
gaps.explanation: 'Apologise for doing something' reports an apology.

gaps.sentence: 'I have to catch the last train,' she said. She said she ___ catch the last train.
gaps.explanation: Have to (obligation) backshifts to had to after a past reporting verb.

gaps.sentence: "Do not touch the wire!" — She warned me ___ the wire.
gaps.explanation: 'Warn somebody not to do' — 'not' comes before 'to'.

gaps.sentence: 'I'm looking for a flat near the hospital,' she explained. She explained that she ___ for a flat near the hospital.
gaps.explanation: Present continuous becomes past continuous in reported speech: was looking.
